data.name: Devaraj
data.gender_notes: Devaraj is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devaraj is a compound name derived from two roots: Deva (God) and Raja (King). It signifies a ruler or king of the gods. The name is associated with power, divinity, and royalty in Hindu mythology. The name Devaraj carries the meaning “God's King” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devaraj usually hope their child will grow to embody god's king and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of divine leadership and rulership.
data.etymology: Devaraj belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's King.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devaraj total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: Devaraj is a revered name in Hindu culture, evoking images of gods and their supreme rule over various aspects of the universe. In Hindu mythology, there are several deities who bear this title, such as Lord Indra, the king of gods, and Lord Shiva, the ruler of the mountain Kailash. Naming a child Devaraj ensures a sense of superiority, power, and majesty, instilling a deep sense of pride, reverence, and respect for the divine and the ancient traditions of the faith.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of Devaraj lies in its representation of the divine connection between the mortal world and the celestial realm. By giving a child this name, parents are acknowledging the divine presence in their lives and expressing their desire for the child to embark on a spiritual journey toward self-realization and ultimately, union with the divine. The name also carries the blessings of the gods, offering protection, guidance, and abundance for the child.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Devaraj is a name which signifies a divine ruler or a king in the heavens. It is a blend of two Sanskrit words - 'Deva' meaning god and 'Raj' meaning rule or reign. This name is a reminder that the divinity within us has the power to rule our inner world and bring us closer to the divine.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Devaraj was a Chalukya king who ruled from 1118 to 1142 AD. The name Devaraj carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
